dateline: Santiago, Chile — November 1970–March 1990 | Accountability under threat, May 2026
heroHeadline: Chile's Memory Infrastructure Under Systematic Attack
heroSubtitle: Kast's government slashed the culture budget 9.81%, threatening the Museum of Memory and Villa Grimaldi, while zeroing the Human Rights forensic program — as 82 organizations filed an IACHR complaint and an anti-pardon bill was killed in committee.
footerNote: Data sourced from Valech Report, Rettig Commission, Vicaría de la Solidaridad, US FOIA declassified documents, Chilean Archivo Nacional, and ongoing judicial proceedings
